# Foodies (Kung Food Pandas)

> A modern culinary community platform to discover, create, and share delicious recipes from around the world.

Foodies allows home cooks and culinary enthusiasts to explore diverse cuisines, filter by ingredients and dietary preferences, publish personal recipes,
and engage with other food lovers.

## Main Navigation
- [Home & Recipe Discovery](https://project-kung-food-pandas.vercel.app/): Browse popular dishes, explore categories, and discover trending recipes.
- [Recipe Creation](https://project-kung-food-pandas.vercel.app/recipe/add): Authenticated dashboard for creating, documenting, and publishing new
culinary recipes.

## API & Documentation
- [Interactive API Docs (Swagger)](https://kung-food-pandas-api.onrender.com/api-docs): Interactive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for recipes, categories,
ingredients, and authentication endpoints.
- [API Health Check](https://kung-food-pandas-api.onrender.com/healthz): Service liveness and readiness monitoring endpoint.
